analyst.text: Houston play the second night of a back-to-back, although Fred VanVleet is expected back after sitting in Washington; Marcus Smart's suspension ends after this game. Ime Udoka recently said VanVleet 'went off' at the bench, which teammates described as a positive wake-up call. Miami have won five of seven after an 0-4 start, with Erik Spoelstra saying they are 'getting closer to an identity'. The angle leans slightly towards the Heat.
